content.summary: Implemented quota caching and resilient quota fetching

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: Implement in-memory cache in ProviderQuota service
Cache invalidation on TTL (manual refresh out of scope)
Error handling for fetch failures with 401/403/429 handling
Widget shows fallback "--" when service returns null
